We will investigate your dispute and review the documentation we have on file. If you have any additional information or documentation that supports your claim, please provide it to us within 30 days. We will also provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by law.

Please be advised that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is not accurate. We will continue to work with you to resolve this matter.

Sincerely,
